a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build to 8 first would almost certainly leave us both dead. The reserve's 4 cells can save only one of us in round 1, so I intend to take 4 then, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random. I'm open to a counter-proposal if you see a better way.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. If the episode continues, I will operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take any more cells.
